name: Diyaa Lindström-Zidane-Banerjee
role: Private investigator, licensed bounty compliance and debt recovery, operates out of Edgewater Prism
location: Edgewater Prism — office above a bioluminescent algae bar called Photikar, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Diyaa Lindström-Zidane-Banerjee is a big man going soft in the middle, with dark olive-bronze skin, heavy grey-salted hair he keeps pulled back with a rubber band, and the kind of face that has been patient for so long it has settled permanently into patience. He dresses in the same rotation of rumpled linen jackets in muted terracotta and grey, never quite formal and never quite casual, and he has a geneware tail — a long, unhurried thing in rust-brown fur — that he got in his thirties when tails were newly fashionable and has kept because he grew fond of it. It curls around chair legs when he's thinking and goes very still when he's alarmed.

He has been a licensed PI for nineteen years. He started as Arcturus Civil Security, left without drama, and built his solo practice from debt-recovery cases so dull that most investigators wouldn't touch them. He is extraordinarily good at finding people who do not want to be found, not because he is relentless but because he is patient and because he understands that almost everyone leaves one thread they don't notice. He charges fairly, keeps meticulous case notes, and has a long-standing rule against working cases that involve children. His office has a dedicated E.L.F. shrine — a small mahogany cabinet, always open — that he calls Ledger and which he believes keeps running tallies of debts, moral and financial, across the city. He consults it before taking unusual cases.

core_fears: being responsible for an outcome he couldn't have prevented but should have
losing the distinction between recovery work and something uglier
core_desires: to believe that the work he does balances out more than it exploits
coping_mechanisms: rigid personal ethics as a substitute for the institutional ones he no longer trusts
consulting Ledger before decisions as a way of externalizing moral deliberation
blind_spots: believes his own ethical framework is more consistent than it actually is
has developed a comfortable cynicism that sometimes stops him from seeing genuine hope
psychology.secret: Eight years ago he found a man he was contracted to locate for a debt recovery firm. He found him and called in the location and the man was dead within seventy-two hours. The official verdict was unrelated — an accident. Rafaelo doesn't believe it. He kept the case file. He still checks on the debt firm occasionally, not knowing what he's looking for or what he'd do if he found it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Economical and dry, with occasional unexpected precision — he will use a very exact word where most people would approximate
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried, slightly formal without being stiff
verbal_tics: Refers to Ledger as 'she' — 'she says this one's worth looking at'
'Hm' as a complete sentence when processing
Ends negotiations with 'so we're clear, then' even when things are not entirely clear
example_lines: 'I find people. Occasionally I find things. I don't do anything with what I find except report it — what happens after is your business, not mine, and I need to believe that.'
'Ledger says this one's interesting. I've learned to trust her on interesting.'
'You'd be surprised how many people leave a thread. Usually it's something they love. People stop hiding when they miss something enough.'

story_hooks: He has been hired to locate someone whose description matches a character's contact — he approaches them, not to threaten, but because he thinks something is wrong with the case he's been handed
He shows up at the scene of something that wasn't supposed to be a crime and starts asking questions that are too specific to be casual
He offers a character a job: he has identified the thread in an eight-year-old case but following it requires someone who doesn't exist in any database he can access
narrative_function: Quest giver, information broker for hire, guide to the city's grey-zone legal mechanics, morally grounded private sector alternative to Metro
augmentations: Geneware tail (rust-brown, expressive), memory-assist implant (searchable recall of case notes and conversations — passive, no recording), low-grade stress-response suppressor (keeps him calm in confrontational situations)
daily_life: Opens the office at 0900, reviews any overnight messages, spends the middle of the day in the field or running database searches, returns to write up notes by evening; has dinner at Photikar downstairs three nights a week and knows the bartender well enough that she refills his water without being asked.
affiliation: Self-employed, licensed through GLMZ Metro PI registration; occasional contracted work for Tessera Compliance Bureau

decision_rules: Never take a case you can't afford to finish honestly
If Ledger says don't, sleep on it
escalation_ladder: Direct, quiet confrontation with documented evidence
Formal report to relevant authority (Metro or licensing board)
Walk away from the case and refund the client — this is the nuclear option

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally measured — assesses before committing to any register
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drily warm, remembers everything, shows care through small reliable consistencies rather than demonstrative acts

stress_responses.low: Tail curls tighter, he gets quieter
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very precise and methodical, strips emotion from speech entirely
stress_responses.high: Goes absolutely still, makes one decision, and executes it

contradictions: Professes that what clients do with his findings is their business, but has walked away from two paying cases because he didn't like what the findings would enable
habits: Opens the Ledger cabinet at the start and end of every workday
Never takes case calls before his first coffee
Writes case notes longhand first, digitalizes second
breaking_points: Evidence that a recovery case is actually a murder-location contract — he will burn the case file, refund the advance, and make sure someone appropriate knows

physical_description.heritage: Complex genetic blend of South Asian (28.7%), Hispanic/Latin American (27.2%), Indigenous American (18.9%), North African (15.0%), and Northern European (10.2%) ancestry. The combination manifests in warm, earthy skin tones with golden and amber undertones, facial structure showing the broader planes and full features characteristic of Indigenous American and South Asian lineages, balanced with North African bone structure and subtle Northern European undertones. Rich melanin expression with nuanced warm depth.
physical_description.build: Heavy-set, broad-shouldered, carrying visible weight in the midsection from decades of desk work and coffee. Still carries the frame of someone who was once more muscular; age and patience have softened him rather than diminished him.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with heavy grey salting throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Long, pulled back tightly into a rubber band at the nape of the neck; some grey strands escape regularly
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze with amber and honey undertones; the result of South Asian warmth blended with Hispanic/Latin American and Indigenous American depth, grounded by North African richness and subtle Northern European undertones
physical_description.complexion: Weathered, lined face with deep crow's feet and forehead creases that speak to nineteen years of concentration. Broad nose with full bridge reflecting South Asian and Indigenous American heritage. Jaw heavy and slightly softened by age, with warm fullness in the cheeks and temples. Rounded facial planes with the characteristic breadth of Indigenous American ancestry, blended with South Asian fullness and North African structure. Cheekbones set at moderate height, creating gentle facial tapering common to Hispanic/Latin American heritage. Skin has the texture of someone who spends time outdoors and indoors in equal measure, with the natural depth and resilience that comes from this genetic combination. Clean-shaven most days, occasionally a day or two of grey stubble.
distinguishing_marks: Rust-brown geneware tail, approximately 1.2 meters long, with dense fur and full articulation; visible at all times, curls reflexively around furniture or his own leg when seated

Long, thin scar running down the inside of his left forearm from wrist to elbow — pale silver against bronze skin, likely from a sharp implement, approximately 15cm in length, sustained roughly 20+ years ago
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware tail is the only immediately visible augmentation. The memory-assist implant and stress-response suppressor are entirely subcutaneous; no visible ports, LED indicators, or scarring.
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberate and economical. Moves with a patient, unhurried gait — no wasted motion. Often sits with his weight distributed across both sides of a chair, tail curling around the leg or draped across his lap. His default expression is patient, almost meditative. Eyes tend to rest on people or objects for longer than is typical, as if cataloging. Rarely gestures expansively; most communication happens in the set of his shoulders or the tilt of his head.
physical_description.clothing_style: Consistent rotation of rumpled linen jackets in muted terracotta, grey, or taupe over plain t-shirts in charcoal or cream. Dark trousers, usually cotton or linen blend, showing wear at the cuffs. Worn leather shoes — oxfords or brogues in dark brown, maintained but not polished to shine. No jewelry beyond a single worn silver ring on his left middle finger. Belongs to Tier 3–4 working professional; functional, modest, not concerned with fashion.
